This report was generated using AI under general human direction. At the time of generation, the contents have not been comprehensively reviewed by a human analyst.

Working review copy of `geocoding-divergence.qmd`, focused on the facilities that `build_geocoded_all()` could not resolve. The pipeline-wired original (`geocoding-divergence.qmd`, target `geocoding_divergence_report`) continues to cover all divergent facilities. This copy reads the same live targets, so it reflects the current pipeline state each time it is rendered.
:::

## What "unresolved" means

When Google Maps and the source coordinate (Vera Institute, Marshall Project, or the project's own geocoding) differ by more than 3 km, `build_geocoded_all()` refuses to pick a side: the facility's final `lat`/`lon` are left NA and the case is flagged for human review. Resolution means adding the facility's DETLOC to the appropriate group in `geocode_source_preference()` (`R/geocode.R`) — `google_maps`, `vera_institute`, `marshall_project`, or `manual` — and rerunning the pipeline.

Hold rooms (IDs 2026–2189) are excluded from this copy. Their Marshall coordinates are a separate, larger backlog — they remain visible in the main divergence report.

```{r}
#| label: load-packages
library(targets)
library(dplyr)
library(sf)
library(leaflet)
library(leaflet.extras)
library(htmltools)
library(knitr)

source(here::here("add-carto-tiles.R"))
```

```{r}
#| label: load-data
# Source R/ functions so geocode_source_preference() is available
tar_source()
facilities_geocoded_all <- tar_read(facilities_geocoded_all)
facility_roster <- tar_read(facility_roster)

unresolved <- facilities_geocoded_all |>
  filter(divergent, is.na(lat) | is.na(lon)) |>
  left_join(facility_roster |> select(canonical_id, detloc, id_range), by = "canonical_id") |>
  filter(id_range != "hold") |>
  mutate(
    divergence_km = round(divergence_km, 1),
    search_label = paste0(canonical_name, " (", facility_city, ", ", facility_state, ")"),
    popup_html = paste0(
      "<b>", htmlEscape(canonical_name), "</b> (ID ", canonical_id,
      ifelse(is.na(detloc), "", paste0(" · ", detloc)), ")<br>",
      ifelse(is.na(facility_address), "", paste0(htmlEscape(facility_address), "<br>")),
      htmlEscape(facility_city), ", ", facility_state,
      ifelse(is.na(facility_zip), "", paste0(" ", facility_zip)),
      "<br>Source: ", source_name,
      "<br>Divergence: ", divergence_km, " km",
      "<br>Google: ", round(google_lat, 4), ", ", round(google_lon, 4),
      "<br>Source: ", round(source_lat, 4), ", ", round(source_lon, 4)
    )
  )
```

All `r nrow(unresolved)` unresolved divergences shown here come from the Vera Institute source (every one of these facilities has a Vera coordinate but no Google-agreeing one within 3 km). Hold-room divergences against Marshall coordinates are tracked in the main report.

## Map of unresolved divergences

Each grey line connects the Google Maps geocode (blue) to the Vera/source coordinate (red). Unlike the main divergence report, all layers are shown by default — these facilities have no accepted coordinate yet.

```{r}
#| label: unresolved-map
#| fig-height: 8
line_features <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(unresolved)), function(i) {
  row <- unresolved[i, ]
  st_linestring(matrix(
    c(row$google_lon, row$source_lon, row$google_lat, row$source_lat),
    ncol = 2
  ))
}) |> st_sfc(crs = 4326)

leaflet(unresolved) |>
  addCartoTiles("CartoDB.Positron") |>
  addPolylines(
    data = st_sf(unresolved, geometry = line_features),
    color = "#333", weight = 3, opacity = 0.7,
    group = "Divergence lines",
    popup = ~popup_html
  ) |>
  addCircleMarkers(
    lng = ~google_lon, lat = ~google_lat,
    radius = 7, color = "steelblue", fillColor = "steelblue",
    fillOpacity = 0.8, weight = 1, opacity = 0.8,
    group = "Google",
    label = ~search_label,
    popup = ~popup_html
  ) |>
  addCircleMarkers(
    lng = ~source_lon, lat = ~source_lat,
    radius = 7, color = "firebrick", fillColor = "firebrick",
    fillOpacity = 0.8, weight = 1, opacity = 0.8,
    group = "Source (Vera)",
    label = ~search_label,
    popup = ~popup_html
  ) |>
  addLayersControl(
    overlayGroups = c("Divergence lines", "Google", "Source (Vera)"),
    options = layersControlOptions(collapsed = FALSE)
  ) |>
  addSearchFeatures(
    targetGroups = c("Google", "Source (Vera)"),
    options = searchFeaturesOptions(
      zoom = 9,
      openPopup = TRUE,
      position = "topleft",
      hideMarkerOnCollapse = TRUE
    )
  )
```

## Near-threshold divergences (1–3 km)

`build_geocoded_all()` auto-accepts the Google coordinate when the divergence is between 1 and 3 km, so these facilities are not flagged as unresolved — but the source coordinate still disagrees modestly, and each case is worth a spot-check. Hold rooms are excluded, as above.

```{r}
#| label: near-threshold-data
near_threshold <- facilities_geocoded_all |>
  filter(divergent, divergence_km < 3) |>
  left_join(facility_roster |> select(canonical_id, detloc, id_range), by = "canonical_id") |>
  filter(id_range != "hold") |>
  mutate(
    divergence_km = round(divergence_km, 1),
    search_label = paste0(canonical_name, " (", facility_city, ", ", facility_state, ")"),
    popup_html = paste0(
      "<b>", htmlEscape(canonical_name), "</b> (ID ", canonical_id,
      ifelse(is.na(detloc), "", paste0(" · ", detloc)), ")<br>",
      ifelse(is.na(facility_address), "", paste0(htmlEscape(facility_address), "<br>")),
      htmlEscape(facility_city), ", ", facility_state,
      ifelse(is.na(facility_zip), "", paste0(" ", facility_zip)),
      "<br>Source: ", source_name,
      "<br>Divergence: ", divergence_km, " km",
      "<br>Accepted: Google (auto)"
    )
  )
```

`r nrow(near_threshold)` facilities fall in this band.

```{r}
#| label: near-threshold-map
#| fig-height: 8
line_features_nt <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(near_threshold)), function(i) {
  row <- near_threshold[i, ]
  st_linestring(matrix(
    c(row$google_lon, row$source_lon, row$google_lat, row$source_lat),
    ncol = 2
  ))
}) |> st_sfc(crs = 4326)

leaflet(near_threshold) |>
  addCartoTiles("CartoDB.Positron") |>
  addPolylines(
    data = st_sf(near_threshold, geometry = line_features_nt),
    color = "#333", weight = 2, opacity = 0.5,
    group = "Divergence lines",
    popup = ~popup_html
  ) |>
  addCircleMarkers(
    lng = ~google_lon, lat = ~google_lat,
    radius = 7, color = "steelblue", fillColor = "steelblue",
    fillOpacity = 0.8, weight = 1, opacity = 0.8,
    group = "Google (accepted)",
    label = ~search_label,
    popup = ~popup_html
  ) |>
  addCircleMarkers(
    lng = ~source_lon, lat = ~source_lat,
    radius = 5, color = "firebrick", fillColor = "firebrick",
    fillOpacity = 0.6, weight = 1, opacity = 0.6,
    group = "Source (rejected)",
    label = ~search_label,
    popup = ~popup_html
  ) |>
  addLayersControl(
    overlayGroups = c("Divergence lines", "Google (accepted)", "Source (rejected)"),
    options = layersControlOptions(collapsed = FALSE)
  ) |>
  addSearchFeatures(
    targetGroups = c("Google (accepted)", "Source (rejected)"),
    options = searchFeaturesOptions(
      zoom = 9,
      openPopup = TRUE,
      position = "topleft",
      hideMarkerOnCollapse = TRUE
    )
  )
```

## Operational context

Presence in the FY26 annual-stats panel and/or DDP daily population data, with best-available peak ADP, to gauge which divergences matter most.

```{r}
#| label: unresolved-context
facility_presence <- tar_read(facility_presence)
source_presence <- tar_read(source_presence)
facilities_panel <- tar_read(facilities_panel)
ddp_fy25_summary <- tar_read(ddp_fy25_summary)
detloc_lookup <- tar_read(detloc_lookup)

fy26_ids <- facility_presence |> filter(FY26) |> pull(canonical_id)
ddp_ids  <- source_presence |> filter(in_ddp) |> pull(canonical_id)

peak_adp_panel <- facilities_panel |>
  group_by(canonical_id) |>
  summarise(peak_adp_panel = max(adp, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(peak_adp_panel = ifelse(is.infinite(peak_adp_panel), NA_real_, peak_adp_panel))

ddp_adp <- ddp_fy25_summary |>
  inner_join(detloc_lookup, by = c("detention_facility_code" = "detloc")) |>
  group_by(canonical_id) |>
  summarise(
    ddp_adp  = max(adp_total, na.rm = TRUE),
    ddp_peak = max(peak_population, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

unresolved_classified <- unresolved |>
  mutate(
    in_fy26 = canonical_id %in% fy26_ids,
    in_ddp  = canonical_id %in% ddp_ids,
    presence = case_when(
      in_fy26 & in_ddp  ~ "Both FY26 + DDP",
      in_fy26 & !in_ddp ~ "FY26 only",
      !in_fy26 & in_ddp ~ "DDP only",
      TRUE               ~ "Neither"
    )
  ) |>
  left_join(peak_adp_panel, by = "canonical_id") |>
  left_join(ddp_adp, by = "canonical_id") |>
  mutate(best_peak_adp = coalesce(peak_adp_panel, ddp_peak))
```

```{r}
#| label: unresolved-context-table
unresolved_classified |>
  arrange(desc(divergence_km)) |>
  select(
    `ID` = canonical_id,
    `Facility` = canonical_name,
    `Detloc` = detloc,
    `Address` = facility_address,
    `City` = facility_city,
    `State` = facility_state,
    `Source` = source_name,
    `Presence` = presence,
    `Divergence (km)` = divergence_km,
    `Peak ADP` = best_peak_adp,
    `Google lat` = google_lat,
    `Google lon` = google_lon,
    `Source lat` = source_lat,
    `Source lon` = source_lon
  ) |>
  kable(digits = 4)
```

## Notes on individual cases

### Migrant Ops Center Main A (404) — 662 km

The largest divergence by two orders of magnitude. The facility's address is an APO/FPO routing address ("Avenue C Psc 1005 Box 55, FPO FL"), which Google resolves to a default mainland-Florida location (26.7°N, 80.9°W, near Port St. Lucie). Vera's coordinate (21.5°N, 77.8°W) is the actual Guantánamo Bay site. The Vera coordinate is correct; resolving this case means adding `GTMODCU` to the `vera_institute` group in `geocode_source_preference()`.

### The county-jail cluster (3–16 km)

The remaining cases are all mainland jails, prisons, and medical facilities where Vera and Google disagree by 3–16 km — typically rural-address geocoding differences, campus-boundary ambiguity, or a stale Vera address. Each needs an individual check of which coordinate lands on the actual facility.

## Facilities with no coordinates at all

Five roster facilities have neither an accepted coordinate nor enough address data to geocode. These need address research (not a source-preference decision); several are DDP-era stubs.

```{r}
#| label: no-coordinate-table
facilities_geocoded_all |>
  filter(!divergent, is.na(lat) | is.na(lon)) |>
  select(
    `ID` = canonical_id,
    `Facility` = canonical_name,
    `Address` = facility_address,
    `City` = facility_city,
    `State` = facility_state,
    `Source` = source_name
  ) |>
  kable()
```
